## Final instructions and summary:
- The PizzaDrop campaign will officially commence at 1 pm UTC on 14th April 2022.
- A form will be published for submitting the entries. (You can include the tweets made earlier than 1 pm UTC on 14th April 2022.)
- The participants need 100000 EDG for the main campaign in the account address they will be sharing through the form. (The snapshot of balances will be taken anytime on the 22nd of May, 2022 aka the Bitcoin Pizza day. The distribution of rewards will be done before 29th May 2022.)
- Participants' tweets must consist of '@EdgewareDAO', '$EDG', '#PizzaDrop' and should fulfil the 'Conditions' mentioned above by @moonrocket16.
- There will be 2 optional activities, of which Activity 1 will have the same criteria as the main campaign while Activity 2 will have no holding criteria and thus anyone can participate in it even if you're not eligible for the main campaign.
- Participants can optionally join the 'PizzaDrop Launch Party' at 1 pm UTC on 14th April 2022 to celebrate the launch and have a campaign walkthrough: [https://discord.gg/QaKJ7Yppx5?event=963925005958258768](https://discord.gg/QaKJ7Yppx5?event=963925005958258768)
